body.statement: Conditional on \(\mathrm{oeq:score-lifting-completeness}\), suppose \(0<V_{\mathrm{eff}}(P)<\infty\), \(K_{\mathrm{fold}}\) is fixed, the primitive conditions of \(\mathrm{lem:learned-projection-convergence}\) hold along the base law and contiguous joint-chart paths, and \(\sqrt nL_n\min\{r_{h,n}e_{q,2,n},r_{q,n}e_{h,2,n}\}=o(1)\). Then \[\sqrt n\{\widehat\theta_n-\theta(P)\}=n^{-1/2}\sum_{i=1}^n\phi_{\mathrm{eff}}(O_i)+o_p(1)\Rightarrow N\{0,V_{\mathrm{eff}}(P)\},\] \(\widehat V_n/V_{\mathrm{eff}}(P)\to_p1\), and \(P\{\theta(P)\in\mathrm{CI}_{1-\alpha}\}\to1-\alpha\). The contiguous-path expansion makes the estimator regular and efficient for the observed joint-bridge functional.
body.justification: The mixed-bias and conditional cross-fit calculations give pointwise asymptotic linearity, variance consistency, and Wald coverage once learned efficient-signal convergence is supplied.
body.gap: That convergence is unresolved, and pointwise rates do not yield the locally uniform contiguous-path expansion needed for regular efficiency.
body.consumer: Wald reporting from the general learned affine ensemble remains conditional rather than certified under the current primitive assumptions.

obligation.what_is_open: Establish the foldwise learned efficient-signal convergence and a locally uniform contiguous-path version of all projection and remainder bounds for the explicit estimator.
obligation.obstruction: The pointwise cross-fit argument requires the unresolved learned-projection conclusion. Regularity and efficiency additionally require a triangular-array expansion uniform along contiguous joint-chart paths; pointwise primitive-rate assertions do not furnish that uniformity.
obligation.attempted: I completed the conditional empirical-process, mixed-bias, i.i.d. central-limit, variance-consistency, and Wald reductions under foldwise efficient-signal convergence. I then checked the claimed contiguous-path step separately and found no declared local-uniform envelopes from which it follows.
obligation.partial_result:
The inference reduction is complete once foldwise learned-signal convergence and the stated mixed-bias rate are supplied. Let
\[
f_k=\widehat\psi^{(-k)}-\theta(P)-\phi_{\mathrm{eff}}.
\]
For fixed \(K_{\mathrm{fold}}\), training measurability makes \(f_k\) fixed conditional on \(\mathcal D_{-k}\) when it is evaluated on fold \(k\). Hence, if
\(\max_k\|f_k\|_{L^2(P)}=o_p(1)\), conditional variance gives
\[
\sqrt n\,(P_n-P)f_{k(i)}=o_p(1).
\]
For each affine cell the exact doubly robust remainder can be written in either primal or adjoint form. Cauchy--Schwarz and the affine-weight envelope therefore give
\[
\left|P\widehat\psi^{(-k)}-\theta(P)\right|
\le C L_n\min\{r_{h,n}e_{q,2,n},\,r_{q,n}e_{h,2,n}\}
=o_p(n^{-1/2}).
\]
Combining the conditional empirical-process term and this drift yields
\[
\sqrt n\{\widehat\theta_n-\theta(P)\}
=n^{-1/2}\sum_{i=1}^n\phi_{\mathrm{eff}}(O_i)+o_p(1).
\]
Under i.i.d. sampling and \(0<V_{\mathrm{eff}}(P)<\infty\), the ordinary i.i.d. central limit theorem gives the stated Gaussian pointwise limit. The same foldwise \(L^2(P)\) convergence, Cauchy--Schwarz, and truncation give
\(\widehat V_n\to_pE[\phi_{\mathrm{eff}}^2]=V_{\mathrm{eff}}(P)\), hence ratio consistency and pointwise Wald coverage.

This reduction does not supply its premise. The learned-signal convergence is exactly the unresolved conclusion of the preceding lemma. In addition, pointwise \(o_p(1)\) statements under \(P\) do not imply the uniform triangular-array expansion along every contiguous joint-chart path that is needed for regularity and efficiency. Such a conclusion requires locally uniform nuisance, Gram, projection, moment, and remainder controls, none of which is declared by the phrase that the primitive conditions hold along contiguous paths.
